findings.description: apply_lava_damage queries (&Transform, &mut Health) without Without<GhostEntity>. Ghost units intentionally carry Health for CRDT damage propagation (guest_snapshot.rs:1151). A ghost standing in the lava pool on the guest side will have health.take_damage() called, which pushes through the CRDT channel and silently reduces the host's authoritative unit HP.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the query filter tuple alongside the existing Without<Corpse> exclusions.

findings.description: forward_dispel_impacts_to_host queries spell_effects with &NetworkedSpellEffect, but ghost spell effects on the guest are tagged with GhostSpellEffect + NetworkEntityId only — they never receive NetworkedSpellEffect. The query returns zero results on the guest, so guest-cast Dispel never forwards to the host and never suppresses any of the host's persistent spell effects.
findings.recommendation: Add NetworkedSpellEffect { kind } to ghost spell effects when spawning them in guest_visuals.rs, or change the forwarding query to join on NetworkEntityId + GhostSpellEffect directly instead of NetworkedSpellEffect.

findings.description: GlobalAttackCycle (struct + Default + tick() method) is defined inside plugin.rs. Convention requires plugin.rs to contain registration only; no types or logic.
findings.recommendation: Move GlobalAttackCycle to shared_systems.rs or a new attack_cycle.rs. Plugin.rs keeps only the init_resource call.

findings.description: apply_game_speed, auto_pause_on_focus_loss, DebugHitboxes, DebugHitboxMarker, sync_debug_hitboxes_resource, and update_debug_hitboxes are all implemented inside plugin.rs, directly violating the registration-only rule.
findings.recommendation: Move debug hitbox types and systems to debug_ui.rs. Move apply_game_speed and auto_pause_on_focus_loss to shared_systems.rs.

findings.description: cleanup_spike_growth_zone has no Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter. On the guest the ghost SpikeGrowthZone has its own time_alive independently incremented by apply_spike_growth_damage. When time_alive >= duration, the guest fires ObstacleChanged::Removed into its pathfinding grid and try_despawns the ghost entity ahead of the host snapshot's authoritative cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the zones query — matching the pattern in cleanup_plague_wind_cloud.

findings.description: apply_spike_growth_damage has no Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter. Ghost zones have damage_per_tick=0 so no numeric damage applies, but the system mutates zone.time_alive each frame, driving the premature cleanup in B2-01, and wastes iteration over all live units on the guest each tick interval.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> filter to the zones query, same as move_plague_wind_cloud and apply_plague_wind_damage.

findings.description: ActionBarSlotText component is defined (components.rs:19) and queried in update_action_bar_slots (lines 348-440) but is never spawned anywhere. The slot_name variable is computed at line 117 and immediately discarded via `let _ = slot_name` at line 224. A comment at line 219 confirms spell names were removed from the action bar, but the dead component, dead query, and dead binding were not cleaned up. Every iteration of slot_text_query silently iterates zero entities every frame.
findings.recommendation: Delete the ActionBarSlotText component, remove slot_text_query from update_action_bar_slots, and remove the (slot_name, icon_handle) tuple and the `let _ = slot_name` discard in spawn_action_bar.

findings.description: The Eternal Slumber instant-kill branch inserts a raw Health { current: 0.0, … } component directly, bypassing apply_damage_to_unit. This skips the is_setup_immune() immunity window active during the MP spawn phase, and the TemporaryHitPoints absorption path. A unit with TempHP could be one-shot through its shield, or a unit could be killed during the setup immune window.
findings.recommendation: Call apply_damage_to_unit(&mut health_mut, temp_hp.as_deref_mut(), health.max * 2.0) instead of directly inserting a new Health component. Requires adding Option<&mut TemporaryHitPoints> to the targets query.

findings.description: spawn_phantom_units runs on both host and VS guest because PhantomFogZone is mirrored to the guest (confirmed in guest_visuals.rs:267) and the system is only gated by is_spell_effects_active (which includes the guest). The guest spawns local phantom units that the host never knows about — unsynced gameplay entities with Health, Team, and Hitbox violating the ghost-gating rule.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(is_gameplay_running) to spawn_phantom_units in fog_cloud/plugin.rs so it only executes on the authoritative host/SP peer.

findings.description: cast_single_banishment and cast_mass_banishment filter enemies with hardcoded Team::Defenders.is_enemy(team). In VS multiplayer the guest wizard is Team::Attackers; their enemies are Team::Defenders. Team::Defenders.is_enemy(&Team::Defenders) returns false, making banishment a no-op for the VS guest. Contrast with mark_of_death which correctly calls local_player_team(session.as_deref()).
findings.recommendation: Thread MultiplayerSession through handle_banishment_casting and banishment_casting_logic, compute caster_team = local_player_team(session.as_deref()), and replace both hardcoded Team::Defenders.is_enemy(team) calls with caster_team.is_enemy(team).

findings.description: Spell::Fireball => [1, 2, 3] — tier thresholds of 1/2/3 are three orders of magnitude smaller than every other spell (MagicMissile: 50/400/1000, BattleHymn: 20/75/200). All three Fireball talent tiers unlock on the very first use. This is almost certainly a debug/placeholder value that was never updated for release.
findings.recommendation: Set Fireball thresholds to values comparable to other offense spells (e.g. [20, 75, 200]). Verify intentionality with the designer before changing.

findings.description: attach_king_spell_shield runs in an add_systems(Update, ...) block with no run_if(is_gameplay_running) guard. It uses Added<King> so it is idle most frames, but it still ticks during menus and loading screens, violating the project convention that every Update system must have a run_if guard.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(is_gameplay_running) or .run_if(is_gameplay_active) to attach_king_spell_shield.

findings.description: rune_display has no OnExit(InGameState::Running) cleanup. When the SP player pauses (Running→Paused) and resumes (Paused→Running), OnEnter(InGameState::Running) fires again and spawns a second rune display on top of the first. roulette_display explicitly guards against this with a comment at line 15; rune_display does not.
findings.recommendation: Add OnExit(InGameState::Running) with cleanup_screen::<RuneDisplayRoot> and OnExit(MultiplayerGameState::Running) with the same, mirroring the roulette_display SP pattern.

findings.description: PauseMenuCompendiumPlugin is missing systems::update_item_active_state and systems::handle_copy_seed compared to MainMenuCompendiumPlugin. In the pause-menu compendium, selected item buttons are never highlighted and the seed copy button is silently non-functional.
findings.recommendation: Add systems::update_item_active_state and systems::handle_copy_seed to PauseMenuCompendiumPlugin's Update sets, mirroring lines 45-46 of the main-menu plugin.

findings.description: apply_healing_plume_heal targets query lacks Without<GhostEntity>. Ghost units on the host carry Health, Transform, and Team; they receive healing ticks and get SpellHealTally / TemporaryHitPoints inserted, corrupting ghost simulation state.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets query filter, matching the pattern in entangle/casting.rs:323 and polymorph/systems.rs:470.

findings.description: handle_mind_control_casting enemies_query has no Without<GhostEntity> filter. Ghost units carry Team, Transform, and MeshMaterial3d<StandardMaterial>, so the host's MC casting can target and insert MindControlled, TraitorsMarkAura, AmnesiaOnExpiry, DominatedUnit, etc. onto the guest's visual mirror entities.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the enemies query filter in handle_mind_control_casting.

findings.description: update_graph_node_borders (the live per-selection-change refresh) omits the affinity-color branch that spawn_study_panels uses at line 558 (AFFINITY_COLOR for prereq-met + has-affinity nodes). When the player changes spell selection, every non-selected node's border is re-evaluated and the affinity highlight is silently lost — the node reverts to plain GRAPH_NODE_BORDER until the next full rebuild.
findings.recommendation: Add battle_insight: Res<BattleInsightData> to update_graph_node_borders and replicate the has_affinity && prereq_met -> AFFINITY_COLOR branch, matching spawn_study_panels line 558.

findings.description: crystal_black_hole_interaction is registered in the gameplay system block (plugin.rs:59) whose comment explicitly guarantees 'every crystal query is gated Without<GhostSpellEffect>'. The function's query has no such filter. A guest's ghost copy of the host's crystal would be pulled toward a local black hole and potentially despawned locally, desynchronising crystal positions across peers.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the crystal query in crystal_black_hole_interaction, mirroring the pattern on every other system in that plugin block.

findings.description: roulette_display spawns on OnEnter(MultiplayerGameState::Running) but has no OnExit(MultiplayerGameState::Running) cleanup. The existing SP comment at line 15 ('cleanup prevents duplicates on pause/unpause') was not extended to the MP spawn path. MP Randomancer pause→resume yields a stacked wheel.
findings.recommendation: Add OnExit(MultiplayerGameState::Running) with cleanup_screen::<RouletteDisplayRoot>, matching the SP pattern on lines 21-22.

findings.description: arcanorouter_display has no OnExit cleanup at all (neither SP nor MP). ArcanoRouterDisplay is tagged OnGameplayScreen which is only cleaned at AppState::InGame exit, not at pause/unpause boundaries. Same duplicate-spawn-on-pause bug as rune_display.
findings.recommendation: Add OnExit(InGameState::Running) and OnExit(MultiplayerGameState::Running) with cleanup_screen::<ArcanoRouterDisplay>.

findings.description: Three heap allocations every frame: units_snapshot Vec (all unit positions), flying_set HashSet, and disorienting_snapshot Vec. On large waves these can hold hundreds of elements, causing repeated allocator pressure in the hottest system.
findings.recommendation: Cache snapshots in Local<Vec<_>> / Local<HashSet<_>> and clear() + extend() each frame to reuse allocations instead of allocating fresh on every call.

findings.description: SpellSchool enum lacks #[repr(u8)]. spawn_school_flare_synced manually maps each variant to a u8 ordinal (0-7) in a match arm. snapshot.rs:690 has a separate SpellSchoolWire enum with a comment saying keep ordinals in sync. Adding or reordering a SpellSchool variant on either side would silently corrupt MP wire encoding.
findings.recommendation: Add #[repr(u8)] to SpellSchool with explicit discriminants (Fire = 0, ..., Transmutation = 7) and replace the manual match with school as u8. This eliminates the dual-enum synchronization requirement. SpellSchoolWire in snapshot.rs can then be removed.

findings.description: ConcentrationSpell.mana_cost is hardcoded to the base MANA_COST (50.0) instead of the talent-adjusted effective_mana_cost. The Meteor Shower talent halves the cast cost to 25.0, but the reservation field stays at 50.0, causing the mana system to over-reserve 25 mana for the entire storm duration and wrongly reducing the wizard's effective mana pool.
findings.recommendation: Change `mana_cost: MANA_COST` to `mana_cost: effective_mana_cost` (already computed at line 240).

findings.description: Nine Update systems (process_create_lobby_result, process_join_lobby_result, process_lobby_chat_updates, process_game_lobby_join_requested, process_game_rich_presence_join_requested, consume_pending_join_in_main_menu, drive_steam_listen_socket, poll_steam_guest_connection_state, steam_transport_bridge_system) run unconditionally every frame with no state guard. During a solo run all nine cross the FFI boundary or drain channels on every tick for no reason.
findings.recommendation: Chain the group with .run_if(resource_exists::<SteamLobbyBridge>) so they no-op during solo play, or add a finer-grained ConnectionMode::Steam guard.

findings.description: apply_wall_of_fire_damage queries WallOfFireEffect without Without<GhostSpellEffect>. Ghost WallOfFireEffect entities spawned on the guest have 0.0 damage but the system still ticks time_alive, writes zero-position TerrainDamageMessages, and may insert InsideWallOfFire / SearingHeatDebuff / FirestormMarked from the ghost. Fireball correctly gates both apply_explosion_damage and cleanup_finished_explosions with Without<GhostSpellEffect>.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the effects query in apply_wall_of_fire_damage, mirroring fireball/projectile.rs:513.

findings.description: cleanup_wall_of_fire has no GhostSpellEffect guard. It will despawn ghost WallOfFireEffect entities when their local time_alive reaches duration, bypassing snapshot reconciliation and leaving a stale entry in SpellEffectEntityMap.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the effects query in cleanup_wall_of_fire, matching the pattern in fireball's cleanup_finished_explosions.

findings.description: update_mass_hysteria_targeting iterates all_units: Query<(Entity, &Transform), Without<Corpse>> which includes ghost entities. Hysteria-afflicted units on the host will steer toward ghost mirror-images of the guest's army instead of real combatants.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<GhostEntity> to the all_units query.

findings.description: update_ogre_targeting queries (With<Boss>, Without<Lich>), accidentally matching Hag, DarkMage, and Ray entities which also carry Boss + TargetingVelocity. In BossParade mode multiple boss types coexist, so this system clobbers their dedicated targeting results (last write in VelocitySystemSet wins non-deterministically).
findings.recommendation: Narrow the query filter to With<OgreEnrageState> (an ogre-exclusive component) instead of Without<Lich>.

findings.description: ogre_combat uses two inconsistent melee-range checks: first pass triggers an attack when any enemy is within (radius_sum) * ATTACK_RANGE_MULTIPLIER (1.5x), but second pass only deals damage within bare radius_sum (1.0x). The ogre can swing, play SFX, and reset its cooldown for zero damage when enemies are in the 1.0-1.5x band.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same range formula (* ATTACK_RANGE_MULTIPLIER) in both passes, or unify into a single pass that checks range once and applies damage to all in-range enemies.

findings.description: cursor_position: Option<Vec2> fields on MouseLeftPressed, MouseLeftHeld, MouseRightPressed, and MouseRightHeld are all marked #[allow(dead_code)] and are never read by any consumer — all downstream spell systems read CorrectedCursorPosition directly. The fields add noise and mislead readers into thinking consumers branch on cursor presence.
findings.recommendation: Remove the cursor_position field from all four message types and the corresponding struct-literal fill sites in systems.rs (lines 80, 84, 99, 103) and gamepad/systems.rs (lines 262-287).

findings.description: God file (1878 LOC) mixing four distinct unrelated concerns: (1) shared movement/targeting helper functions (lines 1–310), (2) DoT simulation systems (311–920), (3) a large material-tinting visual system (939–1202), and (4) sprite-animation driver systems (1204–1845).
findings.recommendation: Split into concern-named siblings: dots.rs (FireDoT/Electric/Frost/Poison/Sickened/Smelly tick systems + process_pending_damage_effects), vfx_tinting.rs (update_persistent_effect_visuals + blend_pulsing_effect), animation_systems.rs (walking/combat/dying/rising animation drivers). Keep movement/targeting helpers in a slimmed systems.rs or rename to movement_helpers.rs.

findings.description: systems.rs is 540 LOC mixing casting, buff application, AoE damage helper, and three distinct talent-reaction systems (retaliating wards, martyrdom, chain ward). Violates the ~300-LOC feature-slice rule.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (handle_guardian_circle_casting + guardian_circle_casting_logic), buff.rs (apply_guardian_circle_buff + cleanup_guardian_circle_shielded), talent_reactions.rs (retaliating_wards_check + martyrdom_on_death + chain_ward_on_death + deal_aoe_force_damage).

findings.description: Linear O(N) entity scan to resolve target_network_id in receive_spell_hit_messages, receive_apply_status_effect, receive_raise_corpse_messages, and receive_dispel_messages (lines 379, 467, 820, 942-951). Each message handler iterates the full units query with find_map. With 100+ units, every message dispatch is O(N). The NetworkEntityMap resource provides O(1) lookup for the guest but the host has no equivalent.
findings.recommendation: Add a host-side NetworkEntityId-to-Entity lookup resource populated in assign_network_ids. Replace the find_map loops with a single O(1) map lookup in all four receive handlers.

findings.description: systems.rs (757 LOC) mixes casting logic, per-livestock-type tick systems (pig flee, dire sheep attack), explosive sheep death handling, Contagious Baas spread, and visual helpers into a single file. Concerns are clearly separable: input/cast, polymorphed-unit lifecycle, and individual livestock behaviors.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (cast input + apply_polymorph_to_target + visual helper), livestock.rs (tick_polymorphed_units, check_explosive_sheep_deaths), and behaviors.rs (handle_pig_movement, tick_dire_sheep).

findings.description: systems.rs is 635 LOC mixing casting logic, talent ticking (doom, executioner brand), death handling (spreading blight, swift hex refund, death's ledger explosion), and visual indicator management. Violates the ~300-LOC feature-slice rule.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs, talent_effects.rs (tick_doom_marks + executioner_brand_check + handle_marked_corpses), deaths_ledger.rs (spawn/apply/update deaths ledger burst), indicators.rs (spawn_mark_indicators + update_mark_indicators + focal_point_retarget).

findings.description: systems.rs is 584 LOC mixing casting logic, evasion application, talent effects (blinding mist, choking fog, rolling fog), phantom unit spawning, zone cleanup, and the public is_in_fog_zone helper. Violates the ~300-LOC feature-slice rule.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (handle_fog_cloud_casting + fog_cloud_casting_logic + spawn_fog_cloud_zone + compute_talent_params), effects.rs (apply_fog_cloud_evasion + apply_blinding_mist + tick_blinding_mist_debuff + apply_choking_fog_damage + move_rolling_fog + emit_fog_cloud_particles + cleanup_fog_cloud_zone), phantoms.rs (spawn_phantom_units + cleanup_phantom_units), utils.rs (is_in_fog_zone).

findings.description: systems.rs is 613 LOC mixing talent param computation, banish_target helper, VFX spawn, casting logic, single-target and mass-target sub-functions, VFX animation update, and banishment expiry tick. Violates the ~300-LOC feature-slice rule.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (handle_banishment_casting + banishment_casting_logic + cast_single_banishment + cast_mass_banishment + compute_talent_params + is_in_spell_range), vfx.rs (banish_target + spawn_banishment_vfx + update_banishment_vfx), tick.rs (tick_banished_units).

findings.description: systems.rs (688 LOC) combines casting, storm pickup, Harvest damage+flash VFX, Psychic Shockwave ring animation, Magnetic Pull drift, Transmutation stack tracking, and indicator animation — five separate concerns.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (indicator, casting state, normal/storm pickup), talents.rs (magnetic pull, transmutation tracking), and vfx.rs (harvest flash update, shockwave ring update).

findings.description: dispeller_movement, shielder_movement, healer_movement, and brute_movement are byte-for-byte identical (~120 lines each) except for the With<MarkerComponent> filter. Four sites of duplicated movement boilerplate that should be a generic shared system.
findings.recommendation: Extract a generic movement system fn standard_movement<M: Component>() in units/movement.rs and replace all per-unit copies. The existing calculate_weighted_movement helper is already there; only the Query wrapper is duplicated.

findings.description: 1682-line god file collapsing 7+ distinct concerns: module-local constants (~120 lines), ~15 component types, 4 resource types, 4 panel-builder fns, 6 spawner helpers, and 10 systems. The project rule states files >300 LOC must be split unless a single match-on-enum or asset registry, which this is not.
findings.recommendation: Split into sibling files: constants.rs, components.rs, panel_no_run.rs, panel_active_run.rs, init.rs, slider.rs, seed_input.rs, toggle.rs, run_summary.rs. Expose pub(super) items via the parent module.

findings.description: 524 LOC mixing 6 distinct concerns: projectile spawn, projectile animation & landing, lifetime/sinking, unit-attack interaction, damage-tint, spell-damage application. Exceeds the 300-LOC limit for non-cohesive files per project conventions.
findings.recommendation: Split into projectile.rs (spawn + animate + land), lifetime.rs (tick, sink, cleanup), combat.rs (units attack, spell damage), tint.rs (damage tint), and a thin spawn.rs for spawn_terrain_boulder.

findings.description: casting.rs at 677 LOC mixes TalentConfig resolution, the BeamAction enum, the core casting state machine, apply_disintegrate_damage, and cleanup_beams_on_cancel — five distinct concerns. Project convention requires splitting oversized files by concern.
findings.recommendation: Split into: talent_config.rs (TalentConfig, compute_talent_config), casting.rs narrowed to the state machine (~200 lines), damage.rs (apply_disintegrate_damage), cleanup.rs (cleanup_beams_on_cancel + despawn_all_beam_visuals helper).

findings.description: apply_finger_of_death_damage is 310 lines and handles beam firing, wall/rock occlusion, soul harvest mana refund, siphon life heal queueing, undead raise resource insertion, necrotic explosion spawning, deathmark debuff application, sound, VFX, mana drain, mouse-state mutation, and talent-progress tracking — a god function.
findings.recommendation: Split into fire_beam_damage (hit-scan + mana drain) and apply_fod_talents_on_fire (talent side-effects), coordinated by the existing apply_finger_of_death_damage entry point or a renamed thin coordinator.

findings.description: The targets query in apply_finger_of_death_damage, apply_necrotic_explosion_damage (effects.rs:131), and update_reapers_scythe (effects.rs:285) uses Without<Wizard> only. In Versus MP the guest has a LocalWizard and host ghost units (GhostEntity) carry a Health component (guest_snapshot.rs:1151-1158). is_spell_effects_active returns true for MP guests, so the guest's local FoD beam will iterate and damage ghost units — double-authoritative damage. Entangle, mark_of_death, and polymorph all already carry Without<GhostEntity> filters with explanatory comments.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostEntity> to the targets query filter-tuple in all three damage systems, matching the pattern in entangle/casting.rs:323.

findings.description: casting.rs (531 LOC) was intended for casting input only but accumulated ground-effect tick (tick_entangle_ground_effect), overgrowth re-root (overgrowth_root_new_units), despawn cleanup (cleanup_entangle_ground_effect), Thorny Vines DPS (thorny_vines_tick), root-expire effects (handle_entangle_root_expire), and mana regen (nourishing_roots_mana_regen) — at least three distinct concerns beyond casting. Exceeds the 300-LOC limit with mixed responsibilities.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (input + mana + indicator, ~170 LOC), ground_effect.rs (tick + overgrowth + despawn, ~120 LOC), and root_effects.rs (thorny DPS, expire, regen, apply helper, ~200 LOC). Update the systems.rs re-export hub accordingly.

findings.description: count_researched_spells, is_prereq_met, and is_spell_unlocked each call load_unified_save() independently. In spawn_study_panels, every spell node calls is_spell_unlocked AND is_prereq_met back-to-back — ~60 mutex lock+clone pairs per rebuild for a 30-spell web. The cache avoids disk I/O but the redundant mutex acquires and clone allocations are wasteful and the triple-load pattern duplicates the same save lookup across three helper functions.
findings.recommendation: Extract a SpellUnlockSnapshot { unlocked: HashSet<String>, researched_count: u32 } built from a single load_unified_save() call, pass it by reference into spawn_study_panels, and rewrite the three helpers to accept the snapshot instead of loading independently.

findings.description: setup.rs is 750 LOC containing 7 distinct concerns: talent-param computation, frame-reset, casting helpers, spawn helpers, visual/lifetime, black-hole interaction, and range-limited despawn. Violates the >300-LOC split rule; not a single-concern monolith.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (handle_arcane_crystal_casting + arcane_crystal_casting_logic, ~160 LOC), spawn.rs (spawn_crystal, spawn_permanent_crystal, spawn_crystal_entity, ~130 LOC), visuals.rs (update_crystal_visuals, cleanup_expired_*, clear_absorption_flags, ~200 LOC), and helpers.rs (talent params, shared math helpers, ~80 LOC).

findings.description: update_ice_explosions iterates ALL IceExplosion entities with no Without<GhostSpellEffect> guard on the explosions query. Ghost IceExplosion entities on the co-op guest have damage=0.0 so health damage is a no-op, but apply_frost_accumulation is called with the full frost_per_hit (0.3 or 0.6 with Permafrost), double-applying frost status/slow/freeze on the guest.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the explosions query in update_ice_explosions. Ghost explosions handle only visuals; the gameplay damage path must be host-authoritative.

findings.description: 440-line file holds 12 unrelated component/marker/resource types: PrimedSpell, Wizard, Mana, ManaRegen, CastingState, GlobalCastCooldown, SpellCaster, LocalWizard, WizardAnimation, WizardAssets, GuestWizard, WizardInput. The 300-line exemption applies only to a single match-on-enum or asset registry; this file is neither.
findings.recommendation: Split into at least three sibling files: mana.rs (Mana, ManaRegen), casting_state.rs (CastingState, GlobalCastCooldown, SpellCaster), wizard.rs (Wizard, LocalWizard, GuestWizard, WizardAssets, WizardInput, WizardAnimation, PrimedSpell). Update components.rs re-exports accordingly.

findings.description: spawn_weather_particles calls meshes.add(Rectangle::new(...)) and materials.add(StandardMaterial{...}) every frame for each weather slot with active weather (up to 8 rain or 6 snow particles per slot per frame). Each add() inserts a new asset handle, growing Assets<Mesh> and Assets<StandardMaterial> without bound over the course of a match.
findings.recommendation: Pre-create particle mesh and material handles in a Resource on OnEnter(Running) (similar to SpellVisualAssets) and clone the stored handles each frame. Alternatively use Local<Option<Handle<...>>> to create on first use and reuse thereafter.

findings.description: spawn_pandemic_clouds queries all PlagueWindCloud entities without filtering Without<GhostSpellEffect>. On the guest, ghost clouds with pandemic=true exist. If a guest ghost unit health reaches zero inside a ghost cloud, the system spawns a new real local cloud via commands.spawn, creating an unsynchronized authoritative cloud on the guest that applies damage and pathfinding updates independently from the host.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<GhostSpellEffect> to the clouds query in spawn_pandemic_clouds, matching move_plague_wind_cloud and cleanup_plague_wind_cloud.

findings.description: Five general mind-control runtime systems (update_mind_controlled_targeting, mind_controlled_pursue_allies, update_mind_control_wear_off, mind_controlled_combat, cleanup_retaliation_targets) live in the hag module but are registered in mind_control/plugin.rs via cross-module paths. These systems implement shared MC behavior not specific to hags and their placement creates a hard architectural dependency from the wizard spell module back into the boss module.
findings.recommendation: Move these five systems into src/game/units/wizard/spells/mind_control/systems.rs (or a sibling mc_behavior.rs) and update the registration and pub-use chain. The hag module should only insert MindControlled components, not own the MC runtime.

findings.description: movement.rs (1102 LOC) conflates five distinct concerns: spawn, body/eye lifecycle, stalk particles, fear movement, and two full beam attacks (disintegration + petrification). The scope note calls this out explicitly.
findings.recommendation: Split into spawn.rs (spawn_ray), lifecycle.rs (body_damage_to_eyes, eye_death_check, all_eyes_dead_check, death_cleanup, dying_eyes), particles.rs (stalk particle spawn/update, beam_visual cleanup), fear_movement.rs (cleanse_fear_with_rage, update_fear_movement), and move disintegration + petrification beams into beams.rs.

findings.description: builders.rs (1650 LOC) mixes two distinct concerns: pure UI spawn helpers (spawn_graphics_tab, spawn_controls_tab, spawn_option_button, spawn_slider_control, etc.) and fully-fledged Bevy system bodies (key_binding_button_action, capture_key_input, rebuild_settings_content, resolution_button_action, update_key_binding_text, update_resolution_selection, update_resolution_visibility, handle_settings_tab_click, setup_main_menu, setup_pause_menu). Convention requires files >300 LOC to be split when multiple concerns are present.
findings.recommendation: Extract the Bevy system functions (lines ~1014-1401) into dedicated sibling files: keybind_systems.rs for key capture and binding systems, tab_systems.rs for tab switching, content rebuild, and resolution systems. Keep builders.rs as pure spawn helpers.

findings.description: rebuild_on_state_change is a single 246-line system body with five responsibilities: (a) tab button visual update, (b) save-data loading, (c) item list despawn+respawn, (d) detail panel refresh, (e) level-history show/hide. Hard to reason about and test.
findings.recommendation: Extract into update_tab_visuals, rebuild_items_list, update_detail_and_history. Chain them in plugin registration to preserve ordering.

findings.description: beam.rs at 742 LOC mixes five distinct concerns: beam spawn factories, four continuous visual animation systems (update_beam_visuals, update_beam_glow, update_beam_origin_flare, update_beam_eclipse), particle/smoke emitters and their helpers, the sweep talent system, and the searing finale system. Project convention requires splitting files exceeding ~300 lines unless every line is a single large match.
findings.recommendation: Split into: spawn.rs (spawn factories + despawn helper), visuals.rs (the four update-visual systems + update_sweep_beams), particles.rs (spawn_impact_particles, emit_impact_particles, update_impact_particles, spawn_beam_smoke, emit_beam_smoke, update_beam_smoke), searing_finale.rs (update_searing_finale_detonations, spawn_searing_finale).

findings.description: `cleanup_expired_walls` contains no `Without<GhostSpellEffect>` query guard. Ghost walls currently have `duration = f32::MAX` (safe), but if duration ever becomes finite the guest would send spurious `WallPlaced{placed:false}` removal messages to the host, corrupting the host's pathfinding grid. No invariant is documented or enforced.
findings.recommendation: Add `Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect>` to the `walls` query filter. Add a comment explaining the invariant. Apply the same guard to `destroy_dead_walls` as defensive documentation.

findings.description: The brew-preview detail-panel content (~130 lines) is rendered twice: once in spawn_detail_panel (setup.rs:245–376, initial build) and again in update_detail_panel_on_selection_change (interaction.rs:143–291, incremental rebuild). Both blocks implement identical logic — ingredient count, brew time with Alchemist bonus, buff duration with Alchemist bonus, effects list, dilution warning, combo list. A bug fix must be applied in both places.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared spawn_brew_preview_content(panel, selection, config, unlocked_combos) helper (e.g. in a new detail_panel.rs) and call it from both sites.

findings.description: 454 LOC across 9 systems covering 4 independent state machines (wet, evaporation/fog, freeze, shock). Exceeds the 300-LOC limit for non-cohesive files.
findings.recommendation: Split into wet.rs, freeze.rs, evaporation.rs, shock.rs, and ripples.rs. Keep spawn_single_pond in a spawn.rs.

findings.description: setup.rs (472 LOC) conflates four unrelated concerns: grid initialisation (lines 30–116), flow-field kick-off (124–141), wave-staging lifecycle including tag_new_attackers, check_wave_activation, manage_staging_speedup, suppress_staging_targeting, and WaveStagingTimers (144–399), and stuck-unit recovery (390–472). WaveStagingTimers is defined here instead of staging.rs where it logically belongs.
findings.recommendation: Extract wave_activation.rs (tag_new_attackers, check_wave_activation, manage_staging_speedup, suppress_staging_targeting, WaveStagingTimers) and stuck_detection.rs (init_stuck_detection, detect_and_recover_stuck_units). Keep setup.rs for grid init, terrain registration, staging field construction, and generate_initial_fields.

findings.description: Most VFX spawn helpers hardcode OnGameplayScreen (fire_effects.rs:194, explosion_effects.rs:105,176, area_effects.rs:66,242,277,311,401,536, cast_effects.rs:37,66,210,293,429). Only spawn_fire_glow takes a generic screen_marker: M — its own doc comment at line 103-110 explains the ghost-path screen marker risk. The same risk exists for all other hardcoded helpers if ghost spell paths call them.
findings.recommendation: Audit each helper for reachability from ghost contexts (guest_visuals.rs, spell_sync.rs). For helpers reachable from ghost paths, apply the generic screen_marker: M pattern. For SP-only helpers, add a // SP-only callsite comment to prevent silent regression during future MP work.

findings.description: All GreaseZone gameplay systems (check_grease_ignition, apply_grease_burn, cleanup_grease_zone, fade_grease_zone, update_grease_regeneration, cleanup_grease_debuffs, update_grease_fire_spread, spawn_grease_fire_smoke) query GreaseZone without Without<GhostSpellEffect>. On the guest client, host-replicated GreaseZone entities carry GhostSpellEffect. These systems will run against ghost zones — causing double-application of slow, burn damage, ignition triggers, talent stuns (Slip and Fall), Oil Slick vulnerability, and incorrect debuff cleanup. All comparable spells (plague_wind, arcane_crystal, meteor_fall, lightning_rod) gate their zone queries with Without<GhostSpellEffect>.
findings.recommendation: Add Without<crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect> to the primary GreaseZone queries in all SP-authoritative gameplay systems. Review fade_grease_zone and update_grease_fire_spread individually — they may intentionally run on ghosts for visual correctness, in which case document this explicitly.

findings.description: spells.rs (811 LOC) mixes four distinct concerns: seven update systems, four helper spawn functions, targeting logic (find_spell_target), and a component definition (PlagueHazardBroadcast). The project convention requires files ≤300 LOC unless a single cohesive match/registry, and this is neither.
findings.recommendation: Split into: spell_updates.rs (the 7 update systems), spell_spawn.rs (spawn helpers + spawn_telegraph_indicators + telegraph_duration/spell_cooldown), targeting.rs (find_spell_target). Move PlagueHazardBroadcast to components.rs.

findings.description: lifecycle.rs is 782 lines containing seven distinct concerns: trigger systems, overlay spawn/despawn, highlight logic, glow animation, button handlers, save/load helpers, and content update. The project convention requires files >300 LOC to be split unless they are a single cohesive match-on-enum or asset registry.
findings.recommendation: Split into concern-focused siblings: triggers.rs (trigger_*, try_start_tutorial, drain/enforce), overlay.rs (spawn_tutorial_overlay, position_tutorial_panel, despawn_overlay, anchor_to_alignment), highlight.rs (apply_highlight, remove_all_highlights, animate_glow), handlers.rs (handle_next_button, handle_skip_button, complete_tutorial, cleanup_tutorial, update_tutorial_content), persistence.rs (load/save/reset helpers).

findings.description: arrival.rs hosts three functions unrelated to teleport arrival: update_circle_animations (animation), cleanup_teleport_on_spell_switch (cleanup), and random_position_in_circle (geometry helper). The 475-line file violates the 'group by concern' convention.
findings.recommendation: Move update_circle_animations and cleanup_teleport_on_spell_switch to a new indicators.rs; move random_position_in_circle to a geometry.rs or inline it into arrival.rs at the call sites.

findings.description: ENGAGEMENT_RANGE: f32 = 800.0 is defined as an inline const inside activate_defenders_on_proximity while DEFENDER_ACTIVATION_RANGE: f32 = 800.0 already exists in constants.rs for exactly this purpose. Two names for the same value will silently diverge.
findings.recommendation: Remove the inline const; replace with super::constants::DEFENDER_ACTIVATION_RANGE.

findings.description: Hardcoded inline LinearRgba literals for Fear (purple: 0.5, 0.1, 0.6) and Petrified (gray: 0.4, 0.4, 0.4) inside update_persistent_effect_visuals. Every other effect color is a named constant in constants.rs; these two are the lone exceptions, creating a doc-drift risk when tuning visuals.
findings.recommendation: Add FEAR_EFFECT_COLOR, FEAR_EFFECT_INTENSITY, PETRIFIED_EFFECT_COLOR, and PETRIFIED_EFFECT_INTENSITY to constants.rs and reference them from the visual system.

findings.description: calculate_effectiveness runs an O(N²) double-pass over all non-boss non-corpse units every frame with no early-out for units already pinned at EFFECTIVENESS_MIN or EFFECTIVENESS_MAX. At 200+ units this is ~40 000 distance checks per frame.
findings.recommendation: Add a dirty flag or simple last-frame cache. At minimum, skip recalculation for a unit whose effectiveness is already at the clamp boundary and whose neighborhood count has not changed.

findings.description: process_pending_damage_effects, update_fire_dot, update_electric_charge, update_electric_arc_visuals, and update_persistent_effect_visuals have no any_with_component fast-exit guard. They run every frame that is_spell_effects_active is true even when zero fire/electric/pending-damage components exist.
findings.recommendation: Add any_with_component guards: PendingDamageEffect for process_pending_damage_effects, FireDoT for update_fire_dot, Shocked for update_electric_charge, ElectricArcVisual for update_electric_arc_visuals, and an OR of all effect markers for update_persistent_effect_visuals — matching the pattern already used for update_poisoned (line 177).

findings.description: systems.rs is solely a glob re-export hub (pub use super::builders::*; pub use super::interaction::*;) with a stale migration note 'Phase 16' that has no meaning to future readers. It obscures which symbols come from which file and exists only as a historical artifact.
findings.recommendation: Remove the intermediary re-export module and have plugin.rs import directly from builders and interaction by name (as the pause-menu settings plugin already does). Delete the 'Phase 16' comment.

findings.description: update_ui_scale runs unconditionally every Update frame with no run_if guard or Changed<Window> query filter. It reads two resources (Window, CrtEffectSettings) and does a float comparison every tick. The project rule states every Update system must have a run_if() guard.
findings.recommendation: Gate with .run_if(on_event::<bevy::window::WindowResized>()) or change the query to Query<&Window, Changed<Window>> so the system body becomes a no-op when the window size is unchanged.

findings.description: handle_slot_click checks exclusive casting via config.wizard_type.uses_exclusive_casting() (line 292), while handle_keyboard_input re-implements the same guard inline as matches!(config.wizard_type, WizardType::RuneCaster | WizardType::Randomancer) (lines 322-325). If a new exclusive-casting archetype is added, uses_exclusive_casting() is the single source of truth and the inline matches! would silently miss it.
findings.recommendation: Replace the inline matches! in handle_keyboard_input with config.wizard_type.uses_exclusive_casting() to match the handle_slot_click pattern.

findings.description: apply_vsync_config maps both VsyncMode::On and VsyncMode::Adaptive to PresentMode::AutoVsync. The UI exposes all three modes as distinct choices. Players who select Adaptive receive identical behavior to On — a visible lie.
findings.recommendation: Map VsyncMode::Adaptive to PresentMode::FifoRelaxed (or Mailbox). If the engine cannot distinguish them, remove the Adaptive variant from the enum and UI, keeping a serde alias #[serde(alias = "Adaptive")] on the On variant so existing saves still deserialize.

findings.description: apply_status_to_entity doc still references 'Phase 1' and 'Phase 3' as future work, but Phase 3 appears to have shipped. Separately, send_coop_level_over (coop.rs:193-195) ships host_spell_damage: 0.0 with a 'WS9 fills these' comment — co-op host spell-stat data is never reported to the guest's co-op history.
findings.recommendation: Remove or update the Phase 3 comment in apply_status_to_entity. Elevate the WS9 coop.rs gap to a tracked issue rather than a dangling inline comment alongside live code that silently sends zeroes.

findings.description: apply_status_to_entity takes polymorph_capture: Option<(Team, f32, f32, Handle<StandardMaterial>, Handle<Mesh>, f32)> — a 6-element raw tuple. At the call site there is no way to see which f32 is HP current, HP max, or base_y without reading the function body.
findings.recommendation: Extract a named struct PolymorphCapture { team, hp_current, hp_max, material, mesh, base_y } and use it in the function signature and match arm.

findings.description: systems.rs is 892 lines mixing five distinct concerns: spawn/asset loading, brew lifecycle, visual effects, host-authoritative army buff application, and multiplayer replication. Per project convention, files exceeding ~300 LOC must be split unless cohesive.
findings.recommendation: Split into spawn.rs (~70 LOC), brew_lifecycle.rs (~145 LOC), visuals.rs (~130 LOC), army_buffs.rs (~290 LOC), and multiplayer.rs (~190 LOC). Update plugin.rs imports accordingly.

findings.description: sleep_casting_logic hand-rolls the same spell-range clamp (Pythagorean ground-radius, center-distance clamping) that clamp_cursor_to_spell_range_with_origin in utils.rs already provides. The identical pattern also exists in fog_cloud and grease (out of scope), making three redundant copies total.
findings.recommendation: Replace lines 192-209 with clamp_cursor_to_spell_range_with_origin(input.cursor_pos, local_origin, wizard.spell_range, effective_radius), matching the pattern Haste uses correctly at haste/systems.rs:106.

findings.description: spawn_single_kings_guard computes its spawn position from a hard-coded centroid of raw castle corner coordinates (centroid_x = -1550, spawn_x = -1450), diverging from how the King itself spawns (WIZARD_POSITION + radius * angle, giving x = -1400). If CASTLE_POSITION or WIZARD_OFFSET ever changes, the guards will not follow.
findings.recommendation: Replace the centroid arithmetic with WIZARD_POSITION-derived coordinates to keep the guard spawn consistent with the King's spawn positioning constants.

findings.description: save_data.rs is 1603 LOC combining five distinct concerns: save structs/serde types (lines 34–535), cache + disk I/O (539–688), wizard CRUD (689–993), meta-progression API (994–1427), and legacy migration (1428–1603). No single match-on-enum exemption applies.
findings.recommendation: Split into save_structs.rs (all Serialize/Deserialize types + default fns), save_cache.rs (SAVE_CACHE, SAVE_DIRTY, load/save/flush/dirty), save_ops.rs (wizard CRUD + meta-progression functions), save_migration.rs (legacy migration), with save_data.rs as a thin re-export hub. No on-disk type changes needed — serde backwards compatibility is preserved.

findings.description: MpSpawnQueue::pop_next calls Vec::remove(0), which shifts all remaining elements on every call. During loading this is called in a tight loop, making the full queue drain O(N^2) in queue length.
findings.recommendation: Change the backing store to VecDeque<MpSpawnTask> to get O(1) pop_front, or reverse the Vec and pop() from the back.

findings.description: Entangle (casting.rs:351, vines.rs:35) and Polymorph (systems.rs:362, 404, 513, 637, 670, 717) use Vec3::distance() (3D Euclidean) for unit area-of-effect hit detection, while Berserker Rage correctly uses xz_distance() (XZ-plane only). Units live on the XZ plane; a unit at a different Y offset (e.g., visual raise animation) can incorrectly fail or pass the 3D check. Telekinesis uses raw dx*dx+dz*dz (correct but inconsistent style).
findings.recommendation: Replace all transform.translation.distance(pos) in AoE hit detection with the shared spells::utils::xz_distance() helper used by Berserker Rage and the codebase at large.

findings.description: Nine talent balance literals are inlined as bare floats in apply_battle_hymn_buff: 1.5 (Inspiring Words duration), 1.5 (War Drums damage), 2.0 (Hymn of Legends double), 0.3 (Anthem Resilience reduction), 20.0 (Fortifying Hymn HP), 0.25 (Swift March speed), 0.5 (echo fraction), 2.0 (Chorus mana factor), 200.0 (Chorus VFX radius). Compare haste/constants.rs and sleep/constants.rs which name every tunable.
findings.recommendation: Add named constants to battle_hymn/constants.rs (INSPIRING_WORDS_DURATION_MULT, WAR_DRUMS_DAMAGE_MULT, HYMN_OF_LEGENDS_MULT, ANTHEM_RESILIENCE_REDUCTION, FORTIFYING_HYMN_TEMP_HP, SWIFT_MARCH_SPEED_BONUS, ECHO_DURATION_FRACTION, CHORUS_MANA_COST_MULT, CHORUS_VFX_RADIUS).

findings.description: MAX_SHIELD: f32 = 20.0 is declared as a local const inside both shield_defenders (line 623) and apply_guest_army_buffs (line 812). The shield keepalive duration 5.0 also appears four times (lines 631, 635, 849, 854). These magic numbers should be shared named constants.
findings.recommendation: Promote to named constants in constants.rs: pub const SHIELD_MAX_HP: f32 = 20.0 and pub const SHIELD_KEEPALIVE_SECS: f32 = 5.0, then reference from both systems.

findings.description: handle_brew_complete calls load_unified_save() (synchronous disk I/O) inside a game-loop system. Although gated on on_message::<BrewCompleteMessage> (fires at most once per brew), a sync disk read can stall the frame for tens of milliseconds on slow storage.
findings.recommendation: Route combo unlock discovery through a dedicated post-brew or end-of-game save system that already performs disk I/O, keeping the message handler free of blocking I/O.

findings.description: SpawnTask::Castle is enqueued in init.rs:81 but the match arm in queue.rs:304-306 is a complete no-op. The castle is spawned implicitly inside setup_battlefield. The variant exists only to document a step ordering intent without any actual work, adding noise to both the enum and the dispatch match.
findings.recommendation: Remove the Castle variant from SpawnTask and its push_back in init.rs:81. If ordering documentation is important, add a comment before the Battlefield arm in queue.rs instead.

findings.description: In update_dispeller_targeting, spell_edge_distance is called twice per candidate pair inside min_by (dist_a and dist_b) and then a third time after the minimum is found to populate distance_to_target. With D dispellers and N spell effects this is O(D * N log N * 3) edge-distance computations per frame.
findings.recommendation: Pre-compute (entity, pos, dist) triples up front via filter_map, store in a sorted Vec, then read the cached distance instead of recomputing it after min_by.

findings.description: Both dispeller_ranged_combat (line 593) and teleporter_ranged_combat (teleporter/systems.rs:580) compute .distance() twice per candidate — once in .filter() and again in .min_by() — when a shared helper find_closest_enemy_in_range already exists at units/systems.rs:1849 for exactly this purpose.
findings.recommendation: Replace the inline filter+min_by chains with calls to crate::game::units::systems::find_closest_enemy_in_range.

findings.description: spawn_coop_gated_button is a UI builder function with branching logic living in constants.rs, violating the 'constants only' contract for that file.
findings.recommendation: Move spawn_coop_gated_button (and GUEST_NOT_READY_BUTTON_STYLE) to a new coop_button.rs peer module, or inline into the two callers (endless_tab.rs, roguelite_tab.rs).

findings.description: Blanket pub use re-exports of three entire sub-modules (animation.rs, status_effects.rs, unit_type.rs) from components.rs mean callers importing from super::components get types from four physical files. The module boundary is invisible to readers.
findings.recommendation: Import from the owning module directly at each call site (super::animation::WalkingAnimation, super::status_effects::FrozenSolidModifier, etc.) and remove the blanket pub use re-exports from components.rs, or narrow them to only the handful of types that are genuinely core-cross-cutting.

findings.description: The static SETUP_IMMUNITY_ACTIVE AtomicBool and its free-function accessors (set_setup_immunity, is_setup_immune) live in a component-data file. Process-global hidden state that is invisible to the ECS makes the module harder to understand and test in isolation.
findings.recommendation: Move the immunity static and its accessors to damage.rs (alongside apply_damage_to_unit which reads it) or to a dedicated immunity.rs file.

findings.description: plugin.rs defines LensingLabel, HeatDistortionLabel, CrtEffectLabel, CrtEffectNode, and a full ViewNode implementation (lines 205-274) — substantial logic beyond Bevy registration. Project convention requires plugin.rs to contain registration only. The sibling nodes (LensingNode, HeatDistortionNode, etc.) correctly live in pipeline.rs, but CrtEffectNode was left behind.
findings.recommendation: Move LensingLabel, HeatDistortionLabel, CrtEffectLabel, and CrtEffectNode (with its ViewNode impl) into pipeline.rs alongside the other render nodes. plugin.rs should only import and register them.

findings.description: load_battlefield_assets has its full system body defined in plugin.rs. Per project convention plugin.rs must contain Bevy registration only; system bodies belong in sibling files.
findings.recommendation: Move load_battlefield_assets to systems.rs (or a new assets.rs) and reference it from plugin.rs via systems::load_battlefield_assets. Update the mod.rs re-export accordingly.

findings.description: ElectricArcVisual component is defined inside systems.rs rather than in status_effects.rs or components.rs where all other effect components live. This breaks the convention that data types live in data files.
findings.recommendation: Move the ElectricArcVisual struct to status_effects.rs (or to the new dots.rs when the U-01 split is done).

findings.description: FIRE_MELTS_FROST_RATE (line 509) and FROST_QUENCHES_FIRE_RATE (line 586) are declared as local const values inside function bodies. These are cross-element interaction tuning constants that belong in constants.rs alongside the other frost/fire constants.
findings.recommendation: Hoist both to constants.rs with appropriate doc comments; all other shared tuning constants already live there.

findings.description: plugin.rs defines two system bodies — action_bar_enabled (line 140) and reset_layout_progress (line 149) — directly in the plugin file. Project convention is strict: plugin.rs is for Bevy registration only; system bodies and helpers must live in sibling files.
findings.recommendation: Move both functions to systems.rs (or a new layout.rs). Mark them pub(super) so plugin.rs can still reference them by path.

findings.description: 414-line systems.rs mixes three concerns: asset loading (load_wizard_assets), entity spawning (setup_wizard, apply_archetype_stat_bonuses), and runtime gameplay systems (mana regen, spell priming, animation, etc.). The project convention is concern-focused feature files, not canonical systems.rs monoliths.
findings.recommendation: Extract load_wizard_assets, setup_wizard, and apply_archetype_stat_bonuses into a sibling spawn.rs. Keep runtime systems in systems.rs. Update plugin.rs and mod.rs accordingly.

findings.description: auto.rs is 1039 LOC containing five distinct concerns: timer-based auto-cast dispatch, persistent auto-disintegrate beam management, Auto-Crystal turret firing loop, Resonance Cascade burst, Crystal Network chaining, plus two spawn helpers. Not a match-on-enum monolith.
findings.recommendation: Split into auto_cast.rs (~380 LOC), turret.rs (~70 LOC), network.rs (~190 LOC), talents.rs (~120 LOC), spawn_helpers.rs (~110 LOC). Update systems.rs re-export hub accordingly.

findings.description: despawn_king_aura_on_death is registered with no run_if guard of any kind. While the Added<Corpse> filter makes it cheap at steady state, it still runs unconditionally in all app states, violating the convention.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(any_exist::<King>()).run_if(is_gameplay_running) to despawn_king_aura_on_death.

findings.description: reset_all_achievements and init_achievements are Bevy systems registered in plugin.rs but defined in resources.rs. The project convention is that resource files hold resource types only. The achievement_locked run-condition helper also lives here alongside resource type definitions.
findings.recommendation: Move reset_all_achievements and init_achievements to checks.rs or a new lifecycle.rs sibling. Move achievement_locked to helpers.rs. resources.rs should only contain resource type definitions and the AchievementResource trait.

findings.description: apply_commander_upgrade accepts _materials: &mut Assets<StandardMaterial> and _meshes: &mut Assets<Mesh> (underscore-prefixed, never read). These force the caller in queue.rs to keep both asset stores in mutable borrow scope for this one call even though no material or mesh manipulation occurs.
findings.recommendation: Remove _materials and _meshes from apply_commander_upgrade and update the call site in queue.rs:555-566. If a future material-swap path is planned, add a TODO comment instead of keeping unused parameters.

findings.description: systems.rs is 790 lines mixing six distinct concerns: casting input, zone damage+CC, lingering poison tick, death-garden growth, spike storm volley, spike storm projectile update, VFX ring emission, and spawn helpers. All other complex spells in scope split their casting from effects.
findings.recommendation: Extract into casting.rs (~260 lines), damage.rs (apply_spike_growth_damage, tick_lingering_poison), effects.rs (update_death_garden, spike_storm_volley, update_spike_storm_projectiles), vfx.rs (emit_spike_growth_rings), spawn.rs (spawn_spike_growth_zone, spawn_minefield_zones). Keep systems.rs as a pub use re-export hub.

findings.description: AttackTiming::can_attack and can_attack_with_speed_bonus — a timer-wrapping algorithm annotated with a comment about a 60-hit-per-second instakill if implemented incorrectly — have zero tests. Also untested: FireDoT::update tick timing + expiry, Shocked::stack cap enforcement, and SlowMovementModifier::apply strongest-wins semantics.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for: AttackTiming wrap-around edge cases, can_attack_with_speed_bonus (bonus=0 fallback, bonus>0 cooldown), FireDoT::update (tick fires at correct interval, expires correctly), Shocked::stack (arc_chance capped at ELECTRIC_ARC_MAX_CHANCE), and SlowMovementModifier::apply (stronger modifier wins, longer duration wins independently).

findings.description: calculate_defender_grid_position carries two stacked doc-comment blocks (lines 664-677 describe a generic attacker-style grid; lines 673-687 are the real defender-grid doc). The first block is an incorrect copy-paste leftover.
findings.recommendation: Remove the first (wrong) doc block; keep only the correct defender-specific comment starting at line 673.

findings.description: is_ray_level() is annotated #[allow(dead_code)] and has no callers anywhere in the codebase. The Ray boss exists but this predicate is never called.
findings.recommendation: Either wire it into the boss spawn/selection logic or delete it to keep the public API clean.

findings.description: The doc-comment on the SPELL_OFFSET constant says 'Offset from wizard position to place the cauldron beside the wizard' — but SPELL_OFFSET is used to compute SPELL_ORIGIN (projectile origin), not cauldron placement. The cauldron has its own CAULDRON_OFFSET.
findings.recommendation: Update the doc on SPELL_OFFSET to describe its actual use as the staff-tip offset for spell projectile origin.

findings.description: ArcaneCrystal.fod_beams_processed and explosions_processed are Vec<Entity> that grow unboundedly for the crystal's full lifetime (up to 25 seconds). They are never pruned after tracked entities are despawned. The .contains() calls at hits.rs:69 and hits.rs:318 are O(n) linear scans that worsen as the crystal absorbs more spells.
findings.recommendation: Replace with a frame-counter approach (store last absorbed frame index per spell type, compare to current frame) for O(1) lookup and zero allocation, or prune stale entries using retain() each frame. A HashSet<Entity> would also eliminate the linear scan.

findings.description: setup.rs is 1435 lines holding layout builders (spawn_detail_panel, spawn_right_panel), click handlers, item-list spawners for all 8 tabs, and the 450-line rebuild_on_state_change mega-system. Far exceeds the 300-line rule and mixes several distinct concerns.
findings.recommendation: Split into: layout.rs (panel/tab skeleton builders), item_spawners.rs (all spawn_*_items functions), handlers.rs (click handlers), rebuild.rs (state-change system). Keep rows.rs for the detail panel update function.

findings.description: DisintegrateBeam.damage_type is annotated #[allow(dead_code)]. It is set once in new() but never read back; every damage system uses constants::DAMAGE_TYPE directly. The field adds noise to every ::new() call and misleads callers who might assume a beam's stored damage type is authoritative.
findings.recommendation: Remove the damage_type field and its #[allow(dead_code)] annotation from DisintegrateBeam. Update new() and any callers. If a future per-beam damage type override is needed, re-introduce it then.

findings.description: toggle_row_action (lines 1395-1418) and handle_unlock_confirmation (lines 1450-1459) each contain an identical loop that finds a ToggleRowContainer entity and writes TOGGLE_ON_BG/TOGGLE_ON_BORDER to BackgroundColor, BorderColor, and ButtonColors, then inserts ButtonActive. The code is copy-pasted with only a minor difference (toggle_row_action can also set the OFF state).
findings.recommendation: Extract a private helper `fn set_toggle_row_visual(commands: &mut Commands, containers: &mut Query<...>, toggle: ToggleModifier, enabled: bool)` and call it from both systems.

findings.description: slider_interaction, update_sliders, and update_slider_text all take ResMut/Res<RogueliteModifiers> as required (non-Optional) params. In plugin.rs they are gated only on resource_exists::<SeedInputState>. The invariant 'SeedInputState present ⟹ RogueliteModifiers present' is implicit, relying on init_roguelite_tab_resources always being called before any SeedInputState insertion. A future refactor inserting SeedInputState for any other reason would cause a runtime panic.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(resource_exists::<RogueliteModifiers>()) alongside the SeedInputState guard in plugin.rs, or use Option<Res<RogueliteModifiers>> inside the systems with an early return.

findings.description: multiplayer_tab/plugin.rs contains four non-trivial system function bodies (route_pending_rematch_from_menu, handle_pending_rematch_on_enter, reset_lobby_on_exit, multiplayer_tab_active), violating the project convention that plugin.rs is registration-only.
findings.recommendation: Move the four system bodies to multiplayer_tab/lifecycle.rs (rematch routing + lobby reset on exit) and leave only add_systems/init_resource calls in plugin.rs.

findings.description: plugin.rs defines two system body functions (update_fire_particle_time, update_aura_sphere_time). CLAUDE.md is explicit: plugin.rs does Bevy plugin registration ONLY. Both functions contain non-trivial iteration logic.
findings.recommendation: Move both functions to a new time_uniforms.rs sibling file (or into fire_material.rs for update_fire_particle_time and cast_effects.rs for update_aura_sphere_time), then reference them by path from plugin.rs.

findings.description: The pattern of walking slot children to apply 3D pressed/rest visuals (ButtonFront BorderColor + ButtonEdge Outline + ButtonAnimState target) is duplicated across three sites: highlight_keyboard_pressed_slots (systems.rs ~515-544), reset_action_bar_on_device_change (systems.rs ~570-584), and tick_commit_flash (radial.rs ~304-334). Each site independently fetches front_query + edge_query and performs the identical if let Ok loop over children.
findings.recommendation: Extract a helper function (e.g., apply_slot_button_state) in src/ui/button_systems.rs or a new src/ui/action_bar/button_visuals.rs that accepts the child slice plus mutable front_query/edge_query references. All three call sites reduce to a single helper call.

findings.description: spawn_action_bar is 193 lines — nearly a third of systems.rs on its own, and the primary driver of the file reaching 603 lines total. It handles the main slot loop, per-slot child spawning, and the debug button, all inline. systems.rs at 603 lines violates the project's 300-line soft limit and needs splitting.
findings.recommendation: Split systems.rs into: spawn.rs (spawn_action_bar + a fn spawn_slot_children helper + spawn_debug_mana_button), input.rs (handle_slot_click, handle_keyboard_input, handle_spell_assignment, effective_slot), and keyboard_highlight.rs (highlight_keyboard_pressed_slots, reset_action_bar_on_device_change).

findings.description: 12 separate incoming_messages.drain(..).collect() + 'unhandled' re-queue patterns across host_systems.rs (6 sites), coop.rs, coop_pause.rs (2 sites), crdt_sync.rs, systems.rs, and guest_visuals.rs. Each allocates a Vec<NetworkMessage>. The pattern is individually guarded but highly repetitive — any future handler omitting the guard allocates unconditionally.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared drain_typed_messages utility or retain_unhandled wrapper so the boilerplate and empty-queue guard are enforced by the abstraction, not by convention at every call site.

findings.description: GOLD_ACCENT is named 'gold' but its value is hsla(270, 0.65, 0.55) — pure purple/violet. The inline comment even says 'Purple accent for active/selected states'. The mismatch misleads designers and developers looking for the gold color vs the purple accent. All other purple constants use 'purple' or 'button' in their names.
findings.recommendation: Rename to PURPLE_ACCENT (or ARCANE_ACCENT) across all six usages: constants.rs, markdown.rs, spell_book/constants.rs, wizard_tower/wizard_cards.rs (two sites), wizard_tower/multiplayer_tab/panels.rs.

findings.description: process_music_fade queries AudioSink directly, but Bevy may not attach AudioSink to an AudioPlayer entity until the audio backend processes it (next frame). If the system runs in the same frame as entity spawn, the entity is silently absent from the query and the first tick of fade progress is lost. There is no comment documenting this implicit timing assumption.
findings.recommendation: Add a comment documenting the one-frame delay assumption, or move the fade spawn to PostUpdate so the sink is guaranteed present when process_music_fade first sees it.

findings.description: detect_beam_hits inlines two Fisher-Yates shuffle blocks (lines 220-234 and 276-291) instead of calling the existing shared helpers find_random_targets_in_range / find_random_enemies_in_range. This creates four total shuffle implementations in the module (setup.rs:138, setup.rs:183, hits.rs:231, hits.rs:287).
findings.recommendation: Replace the two inline shuffle blocks in detect_beam_hits with calls to the existing find_random_targets_in_range helper in setup.rs.

findings.description: plugin.rs defines three system bodies: handle_main_menu_back_button, handle_pause_menu_back_button, cleanup_compendium_state. Convention requires plugin.rs to be registration-only.
findings.recommendation: Move these three functions to handlers.rs (or setup.rs) and import them in plugin.rs.

findings.description: Module-level doc claims 'P2P WebRTC communication' with 'copy-paste SDP signaling'. The transport has been fully rewritten to iroh/QUIC — WebRTC, SDP, and ICE no longer exist in the codebase.
findings.recommendation: Update the module doc to reflect the iroh/QUIC + base64url ticket-code flow.

findings.description: Seven log_*_state_transitions system bodies are defined directly in plugin.rs (lines 99–179). Project convention requires plugin.rs to contain registration only — no system bodies or helper functions.
findings.recommendation: Move the seven logging systems to a new src/state/debug_logging.rs (gated #[cfg(debug_assertions)], pub(super)), and import them from plugin.rs.

findings.description: The seven debug-logging Update systems have no run_if guard. They are scheduled every frame; Bevy resolves all their parameters (including Option<Res<State<T>>> for sub-states that may not exist) on every Update tick, even when no state has changed.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(state_exists::<T>()) for sub-state loggers, and consider a single generic helper or change_detection-only scheduling to avoid per-frame overhead.

findings.description: BASE_RADIUS = 3000.0 and BASE_HEIGHT = 100.0 are duplicated as local const blocks inside both setup_spell_range_indicator (lines 19-21) and update_spell_range_indicator (lines 57-59). BASE_RADIUS exactly equals DEFAULT_SPELL_RANGE from wizard/constants.rs but the existing constant is not reused, so a future change to the default spell range would silently desync the indicator.
findings.recommendation: Hoist the two constants to module level in spell_range_indicator/constants.rs (or import DEFAULT_SPELL_RANGE from wizard/constants.rs for BASE_RADIUS) and reference them from both functions.

findings.description: GhostSpellEffect is referenced as an inline full path (crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect) 5 times in auto.rs and 5 times in hits.rs but is never imported at the top of either file. setup.rs already uses a proper use import for its multiplayer types.
findings.recommendation: Add 'use crate::game::multiplayer::components::GhostSpellEffect;' to both auto.rs and hits.rs and replace all 10 inline paths.

findings.description: The forked-fan beam emission pattern (select offsets [-angle,0,+angle] or [0], compute rotated directions, spawn beams) is duplicated across 3 sites: auto.rs:333 (spawn_crystal_disintegrate_beam), auto.rs:576 (auto_cast_fod_beams), and hits.rs:342 (detect_beam_hits FoD case). The FoD absorption and FoD auto-cast sites are structurally identical.
findings.recommendation: Extract a shared spawn_fod_beams_for_targets helper taking (origin, targets, range, empowerment, damage_per_tick, talent_cfg, lifetime) that handles the fan pattern internally. Place in spawn_helpers.rs when created.

findings.description: PlagueSmoke.spawn_y is used as a boolean sentinel: spawn_y > 0.0 means this is a fire puff (with height-based billowing). Non-fire smoke sets spawn_y = 0.0. A fire puff spawned at world y=0 (e.g., unit dying at ground level) would be silently misclassified as non-fire, losing all height-based scale/sway behaviour. Confirmed at area_effects.rs:612-613.
findings.recommendation: Add is_fire: bool field to PlagueSmoke, or introduce a zero-cost FireSmokePuff marker component so update_plague_smoke can query Has<FireSmokePuff> instead of the spawn_y sentinel.

findings.description: The beam-origin / range-clamped-target / direction / length computation (beam_origin, to_target, clamped_target, direction, beam_length) is copy-pasted verbatim across both the Channeling arm (lines 414-430) and the Casting arm (lines 458-476) of the CastingState match. The only difference is the resulting BeamAction variant.
findings.recommendation: Extract a compute_beam_geometry(wizard_pos: Vec3, target_pos: Vec3, spell_range: f32) -> (Vec3, Vec3, f32) helper returning (origin, direction, length) and call it from both arms.

findings.description: The 8-line block that clamps cursor to spell range, computes beam direction, and computes beam_length is copy-pasted verbatim in both the CastingState::Casting branch (lines 286-302) and the CastingState::Resting branch (lines 345-358). utils.rs already exports clamp_to_spell_range (line 257) for exactly this purpose.
findings.recommendation: Extract to a private helper compute_beam_direction_and_length(cursor_pos, beam_origin, wizard_range) -> (Vec3, f32) or call utils::clamp_to_spell_range; eliminate both duplicate blocks.

findings.description: materials.get(&handle).cloned().unwrap_or_default() silently substitutes a blank StandardMaterial when the asset has not loaded. This yields invisible geometry with no log. The same silent fallback appears in effects.rs:102 (spawn_necrotic_explosion) and effects.rs:419 (sweep visual trail) — five total sites across both files.
findings.recommendation: Use .unwrap_or_else(|| { warn!("FoD: material asset not loaded, using default"); StandardMaterial::default() }) at all five sites to make invisible-geometry regressions observable.

findings.description: FoD manually inline-clamps cursor to wizard.spell_range in two places. disintegrate/casting.rs:420-425 has an identical inline clamp. The shared helper utils::clamp_to_spell_range (utils.rs:257) exists but both beam spells bypass it.
findings.recommendation: Both spells should call utils::clamp_to_spell_range(cursor_pos, beam_origin, wizard.spell_range) to keep range enforcement consistent and centralized.

findings.description: Five fields on IceProjectile and IceExplosion are annotated #[allow(dead_code)]: damage_type, radius, empowerment (×2). If genuinely never read they bloat every spawned component. If intended for future use or networking introspection that intent is undocumented.
findings.recommendation: Audit actual reads. Remove unused fields or replace #[allow(dead_code)] with a // used by: ... comment naming the consumer.

findings.description: systems.rs (656 LOC) combines casting input, buff application, and five independent talent tick/event-response systems (Undying Fury trigger+tick, Frenzy check, Contagious Rage spread, Final Stand explosion, cleanup). Casting+buff is ~300 LOC; talent effects are ~350 LOC.
findings.recommendation: Split into casting.rs (input, cast state, apply_berserker_rage_buff, compute_talent_params) and talent_effects.rs (undying_fury_trigger, tick_undying_fury_active, frenzy_check_system, contagious_rage_spread, final_stand_explosion, update_final_stand_vfx, cleanup_berserker_rage_talents).

findings.description: ABSOLUTE_ZERO_SLOW_PER_FRAME is added once per frame with no delta multiplication. At 30 FPS the slow stacks at half the rate of 60 FPS. Other per-second quantities in the same function (mana drain, DPS) are correctly delta-scaled.
findings.recommendation: Rename to ABSOLUTE_ZERO_SLOW_PER_SEC, multiply by delta at call sites. Adjust constant to keep same 60-FPS feel (0.005 * 60 = 0.3/s).

findings.description: gravity.rs is 446 lines and is named as if it only holds gravitational physics, but it owns all live-effect systems: gravity, corpse gravity, damage, crushing pressure, dimensional rift, visuals update, singularity/despawn, and SFX cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Split into gravity.rs (~120 lines, apply_gravitational_forces + apply_corpse_gravity_and_despawn), damage.rs (apply_black_hole_damage, apply_crushing_pressure, apply_dimensional_rift, remove_units_from_black_hole), lifecycle.rs (update_black_hole_visuals, despawn_expired_black_holes, cleanup_black_hole_sfx).

findings.description: chain_lightning_casting_logic (and mind_control/casting.rs:194) inline the release-cancel pattern (if input.just_released { casting_state.cancel(); return false; }) instead of calling the shared handle_spell_release helper from spells/utils.rs. The inline version skips cleanup_spell_caster, which is load-bearing for indicator cleanup. Mind Control's Mass Hysteria mode spawns an indicator that may not be cleaned up on release.
findings.recommendation: Replace inline release checks with handle_spell_release in both chain_lightning_casting_logic and handle_mind_control_casting, threading commands and caster_query through as needed.

findings.description: enforce_tutorial_modality and drain_pending_tutorials run unconditionally every Update frame with no outer run_if guard. Both have cheap Option<Res<ActiveTutorial>> early returns but Bevy still schedules and dispatches both systems on every frame even when no tutorial has ever been shown.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(resource_exists::<ActiveTutorial>.or(resource_exists::<PendingTutorials>)) around the chain, or at minimum .run_if(resource_exists::<ActiveTutorial>) for enforce_tutorial_modality.

findings.description: sync_achievements_to_steam runs unconditionally in Update with no run_if guard. Even with an empty MessageReader the system still schedules, acquires the Client borrow, and calls client.user_stats() every frame.
findings.recommendation: Add .run_if(on_event::<AchievementUnlockedMessage>()) or the MessageReader-based equivalent so the system only runs when there is actually a message to process.

findings.description: storm_lightning in effects.rs and spawn_weather_overlays in visuals.rs (line 11) both carry the identical stale doc comment '/// Applies the Drought healing reduction to a heal amount. Returns the (possibly reduced) heal amount.' — a copy-paste leftover that describes neither function.
findings.recommendation: Replace with accurate doc comments describing the actual function behavior in each file.

findings.description: apply_weather_status declares `_units_with_wet: Query<Entity, With<WetModifier>>` but never reads it. The underscore prefix suppresses the warning but the query still adds Bevy query overhead every frame for zero functional gain.
findings.recommendation: Remove the `_units_with_wet` parameter entirely from apply_weather_status.

findings.description: plugin.rs defines two system bodies (init_talent_resources and cleanup_talent_resources) in violation of the project rule that plugin.rs does Bevy registration only.
findings.recommendation: Move both functions to resources.rs (they are resource lifecycle helpers) and keep plugin.rs as pure registration.

findings.description: line_segment_intersects and push_out implementations in Tree (lines 34-62, 76-96) are byte-for-byte copies of the same methods in Boulder (boulder/components.rs:46-74, 79-100). Two identical circle-geometry helpers duplicated across two component types.
findings.recommendation: Extract circle_segment_intersect(center: Vec2, radius: f32, start: Vec3, end: Vec3) -> Option<f32> and circle_push_out(center: Vec2, radius: f32, point: Vec3, unit_radius: f32) -> Option<Vec3> into terrain/utils.rs, then delegate from both Tree and Boulder impls.

findings.description: The wildcard _ arm of the match on tier % BOSS_CYCLE_LENGTH (which spawns an Ogre) is unreachable dead code. The enclosing guard on line 203 is is_boss_level(level) && !is_lich_level(level). is_lich_level is exactly tier%5==1, so tier residue 1 is excluded before the match. The wildcard silently absorbs any future cycle-length change rather than panicking.
findings.recommendation: Replace _ => with an explicit 1 => arm containing unreachable!("lich levels are excluded by the outer guard") and a comment explaining the invariant. This catches bugs if BOSS_CYCLE_LENGTH changes.

findings.description: ConnectionState::WaitingForSignaling doc says 'exchange signaling codes', ConnectionState::Connecting says 'SDP exchange complete, waiting for data channel', and NetworkConnection::local_code says 'Base64-encoded SDP+ICE code'. None are accurate for iroh/QUIC.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite all three doc comments to describe the iroh ticket flow: WaitingForSignaling = endpoint not yet ready, Connecting = endpoint bound/connecting, local_code = base64url EndpointAddr ticket.

findings.description: fragment_datagram silently truncates payloads that produce more than 255 chunks (.min(255) as u8). Extra chunks are iterated but the receiver expects exactly fragment_count pieces — it will never complete a truncated reassembly, silently dropping the message with no error log.
findings.recommendation: Add an early-return with a warn!() when chunks.len() > 255, or assert the invariant. Real payloads should be well within limits, but silent truncation is a correctness hazard.

findings.description: collect_dispellable_effects allocates a fresh Vec<_> inside the per-impact loop. The Vec is rebuilt every frame for each active impact, iterating all networked spell effects each time.
findings.recommendation: Hoist the Vec allocation outside the impacts loop — collect once before the 'for ... in &mut impacts' block, then borrow &all_dispellable inside the loop.

findings.description: casting.rs is 577 lines. The bottom half (find_nearest_corpse, raise_corpse_as_undead, resurrect_nearest_corpse, try_raise_or_forward) is raising mechanics, not casting input logic. effects.rs already imports from here.
findings.recommendation: Move the four raising-mechanics functions to a new raising.rs sibling (~300 lines). casting.rs becomes ~200 lines.

findings.description: guard_entities Vec is populated in the pre-pass loop of martina_teleport_pull (lines 662-671) but is never read afterward. The comment at line 728 defers guard teleporting to 'their existing system', making this a dead allocation every time the ability fires.
findings.recommendation: Remove the guard_entities Vec, the Option<&KingsGuard> query component, and the populating branch — or implement the missing guard-teleport logic if still intended.
